summary: Planban 1.0.5 adds agent-led feedback triage that gathers available evidence, searches for related reports, and recommends a pull request only for fixes already implemented and verified locally.
updatePrompt: Install or update Planban from piercekearns/planban, verify the plugin and MCP tools are available, then ask the agent to report a bug and confirm it investigates first, searches for related issues, and does not recommend a pull request without an implemented and verified local fix.
changelogSummary: Planban now turns rough feedback into an evidence-backed issue or eligible fix PR without blocking users on details their agent cannot recover.
